trainer/30855.htm.text: Magister Desmond: Even though everyone regards the Ivory Tower as the center of the magic-using universe, its luster is fading. Soon the Wizards Guild of Aden will eclipse it in power and acclaim. Our day is coming!

trainer/30855-noteach.htm.text: Magister Desmond: We shall rule the world! Er, I mean to say... We strive to achieve global peace! I don't have time to discuss policy with you, go and ask someone else. I teach Human mages. If you know any, tell them to come and see me. Seriously, don't let them go anywhere else! Ha!

Q00372_LegacyOfInsolence/30855-02.html.text: Magister Desmond: Is this the entire set of the "Revelation of the Seals"? Ah, yes! Give them here! Now I am so much closer to discovering the secret of the seven seals! Soon we, the Revolutionaries of Dusk, will rule the world! Here is your reward. If you find any more of these kind of books, brin…

Q00372_LegacyOfInsolence/30855-01.html.text: Magister Desmond: You're bringing the "Revelation of the Seals", aren't you? Here, let me see. What's this? You didn't bring them all! Go get the rest! I'll hold onto these for now. When you bring more, I'll send them to my superior! Then you shall receive your reward.

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
